assert find_Min_Sum([1,2,3],[4,5,6],3) == 9
assert find_Min_Sum([4,1,8,7],[2,3,6,5],4) == 6

Write the t task named `find_Min_Sum` with 3 parameter(s) of type(s) seq, seq, int, in the order the tests pass them, returning int. The tests must pass and the ensures must specify the result.
